name: oee-ops
description: Compute OEE correctly — TRS, TRG and TRE per AFNOR NF E 60-182, mapped to Nakajima's OEE/OOE/TEEP and ISO 22400. Time buckets as interval sets, exact A x P x Q factorisation, correct roll-ups, loss waterfalls and Pareto. Ships a deterministic benchmark.

interface.shortDescription: OEE / TRS that survives an audit.
interface.longDescription: The OEE arithmetic is three multiplications; everything that goes wrong is upstream of it. This skill covers the nine errors that produce a plausible wrong rate — averaging rates across machines or days, summing overlapping stop logs, stops crossing the window, circular performance rates, stale nominal cycle times, and the wrong denominator — with time buckets computed as interval sets, an exact TRS = DO x TP x TQ factorisation per NF E 60-182, loss waterfalls, Pareto by cause, and a deterministic benchmark on numbers you can check on paper.
defaultPrompt: Compute the TRS for this shift and show me where the time went
